comparison.objective: Empty a robot vacuum dustbin into a waste box and reinstall it.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold and orient a bin while pressing a release, control granular discharge, then reseat it.
comparison.success_condition: At least 9 of 10 particles contained, minimal spill, bin seated with doors shut and arms returned.
comparison.reason: Tests hold-to-release dumping, containment and reseating, not fine rotary adjustment, tightening torque or repeated dynamic qualification.
